people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Ephron
people.line: A Hittite who sold a burial site to Abraham.

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

people.name: Machpelah
people.line: A cave near Hebron; burial place of patriarchs

people.name: Mamre
people.line: A place near Hebron; associated with Abraham

translations.web: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.
translations.bsb: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave at Machpelah in the field near Mamre, which Abraham had purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
translations.kjv: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
translations.asv: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, for a possession of a burying-place, of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
